rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Indonesia is under a general advisory to exercise a high degree of caution due to political and social tensions, terrorism threats, and violent crime throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include all provinces of Indonesian Papua (except Raja Ampat Regency and Sorong city) due to violent incidents, militant threats, and kidnapping risks, as well as Aceh province and East and West Kalimantan due to kidnapping threats.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Thailand is under an overall advisory to exercise a high degree of caution due to ongoing political tensions, sporadic demonstrations, and a persistent threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include the Thailand-Cambodia border (avoid all travel due to armed clashes and land mines) and the southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, and southern Songkhla (avoid all travel due to violent separatist insurgent attacks). Political instability and military-enforced measures may also disrupt travel.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises exercising a high degree of caution for travel to Türkiye due to the threat of terrorist attacks and possible demonstrations throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include areas within 10 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria, where travel should be avoided entirely, and the southeastern provinces of Hakkari and Șirnak, where non-essential travel is discouraged due to an unpredictable security situation and terrorism risks.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises Canadians to exercise a high degree of caution in Egypt due to ongoing tensions, an unpredictable security situation, and the threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include Northern Sinai (avoid all travel due to terrorist activity and military operations), the Western Desert and Libyan border area (avoid all travel due to smuggling, terrorist activities, and armed groups), and the northern part of South Sinai (avoid non-essential travel due to terrorism).

The Government of Canada advises against all travel to Kuwait due to a volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity and missile/drone attacks that have struck civilian infrastructure. There is also a persistent threat of terrorism targeting foreign military installations, places of worship, and public areas frequented by foreigners. The advisory highlights risks of petty crime, violent crime in specific areas like Jleeb Al-Shuyoukh, cybercrime, and unexploded ordnance hazards near the Iraq border.

Avoid non-essential travel to Israel due to the volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity, potential rocket and mortar fire, and high tensions. Specific areas with higher warnings include Jerusalem (avoid non-essential travel), the Golan Heights border with Syria (avoid all travel), the Lebanon border zone (avoid all travel), and the Gaza Strip border area (avoid all travel). The West Bank also faces heightened risks due to frequent violent clashes and military operations.
